name: settings-row
title: Settings Row
description: A borders-only settings layout — titled sections, bordered cards, label-plus-control rows whose controls share one width and right edge (controlSize), and a settings × channels switch matrix with its column names once.

meta.whenToUse: Settings/preferences screens — titled sections, bordered cards, label/description + control rows, and a rows × channels matrix (Push / Email) of switches.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form content surfaces (Card), data tables, or complex multi-field forms.
